song.name: The Long Watch
song.plot: Before Nyktoros wakes: Vorgos, Sentinel of the Aether, keeps the endless watch where the three planes turn. Two soul-leaks drain the light — Acheron's vampiric soul-banking in Eldoria and Malakar's ritual sacrifices in Nythoria — and the Underworld's soul-pool nears critical mass. The sleeping Void stirs beneath. The scale bends, but the Stormbringer does not bow. Viking opener of the trilogy.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first (viking rewrite of the original opener). POV: Vorgos the Stormbringer, first person. Short punchy chorus ("Rise, storm, rise / Hold, heart, hold") so Suno cannot drift into a generic melodic chorus. Verse 1: the three worlds turn in the Aether's hand, the keeper counts the souls sinking below. Verse 2 names the two leaks (Eldoria hoarding, Nythoria bleeding) that feed the floor of the deep. Bridge is Vorgos's own weight — keeper of the load, does not bend. Anchors: the Aether, the three planes, the sleeping Void, the Stormbringer's domain. No Nyktoros-awake, no Rift, no Anya, no Seraphina/Valen, no battle imagery. Audio-produced and approved by creator.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: Cold is the throne of the endless watch, Where the three worlds turn in the Aether's hand. I count the souls as they sink below, And the deep grows fat on the light we lend.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Rise, storm, rise, The night has found the gate. Hold, heart, hold, I stand against the weight.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: Eldoria hoards, Nythoria bleeds, Two rivers run to the floor of the deep. The scale that I carry bends and bends, But a keeper does not bend, and does not weep.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Rise, storm, rise, The night has found the gate. Hold, heart, hold, I stand against the weight.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: I am the Stormbringer, keeper of the load, The storm is gathered in my silent chest. I do not bow, I only watch and weigh, And what the balance asks, I will not rest.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: Rise, storm, rise, The night has found the gate. Hold, heart, hold, I stand against the weight.

section.name: Outro
section.reworked: Rise, storm, rise... Hold, heart, hold...
